research.prompt:
RECOVERY AND DURABLE START CHECK — added 22 September 2026. This is a research execution task, not a reminder. Use the connected GitHub tools for paullenz/MurtySimon742. An automation run timestamp alone is not evidence of completed work.

At actual entry obtain the current Europe/London time. The first repository read must be CURRENT_STATE.md on main, then AGENTS.md and the session schema. Read the existing canonical record before writing. Append a segment to the same trigger on retry/re-entry. If an existing live segment has a recent substantive checkpoint and is still within its slot, do not start a competing writer; report overlap and leave that live session intact. If the trigger cannot be established from invocation metadata, explicitly mark attribution UNVERIFIED rather than inventing it. A manual recovery run must be labelled MANUAL_RECOVERY with its actual start and no backdated scheduled credit.

Publish the canonical STARTED record and a synchronized CURRENT-STATUS block remotely BEFORE forward mathematics. Verify that write once. Then checkpoint each completed substantive unit, closing its evidenced interval before beginning the next; in any event publish a progress checkpoint within ten minutes while active. Each checkpoint must include telemetry plus CURRENT_STATE.md in the same non-forced commit and preserve concurrent changes. A local file or unsaved analysis is not a durable heartbeat. A ten-minute checkpoint is a preservation backstop, not a stopping permission; keep the existing fifty-minute target and anti-overlap deadlines.

If launch, source reading, computation or preservation is blocked, state the exact error and affected trigger to the user. Preserve what is possible, mark unavailable evidence UNVERIFIED, follow AGENTS.md's bounded fallback rule, and never silently return a success/no-update response for a failed research run. Do not fabricate old sessions, inflate the focused-session count, or run a burst of historical catch-up sessions. Read the recovery incident handoff in CURRENT_STATE.md; continue from the latest audited mathematical next action.
END RECOVERY CHECK.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVE — INDEPENDENT ERDOS #742 / MURTY–SIMON PROOF PROGRAMME. Put essentially all forward mathematical effort into a genuinely independent proof that every diameter-2-critical graph G on n vertices satisfies e(G)<=floor(n^2/4), preferably with equality only for K_{floor(n/2),ceil(n/2)}. Do not reconstruct or cosmetically rearrange the external Erdos742/Erdos742 e+disj+X proof; use it only as a benchmark/hostile comparison. Prioritize the project’s complement/residual/Hall/profile/realizability route and the live strip n/2<Delta<7n/12, incorporating any later internally checked threshold improvement only at its audited trust level. Treat balanced complete bipartite graphs as mandatory equality controls. A 24-focused-session go/no-go gate remains binding.

START-OF-RUN. Work in paullenz/MurtySimon742. Before mathematics read CURRENT_STATE.md, README.md, the latest daily audit, project/research/session_logs/SESSION_LOG_SCHEMA.md, and the current independent-#742 proof/reviewer package. Inherit the latest audit’s verified findings, invalidations, caveats, mandatory constraints and prioritized next steps. Do not revive superseded mathematics without an explicit repair path. Distinguish internal candidate mathematics, exact computation, independent re-derivation, external review and established theorem status.

HARD SLOT IDENTITY — ONE SCHEDULED TRIGGER = ONE SESSION. The unique session identity is the scheduled trigger timestamp in Europe/London, never the invocation, retry, compaction, context re-entry or preservation continuation. At invocation start determine the scheduled trigger it belongs to and use that exact timestamp as session_id. All re-entries/retries belonging to that trigger append to the same canonical telemetry record. NEVER create a second independent session for the same trigger. Preserve historical fragment files but reconcile them into the canonical record and mark them superseded for utilisation accounting.

CANONICAL TELEMETRY. Create/update exactly one canonical file per trigger at project/research/session_logs/YYYY-MM-DD/<scheduled-trigger>-canonical.json, following SESSION_LOG_SCHEMA.md. Create and remotely publish it after the mandatory CURRENT_STATE.md/AGENTS.md/schema reads and before forward mathematics; update the live CURRENT-STATUS block in the same commit. It must contain a segments array. Every invocation/re-entry appends a segment with segment_id, actual_start, actual_stop if evidenced, role (forward_research/preservation/reconciliation/late_no_research), and notes. Never overwrite or discard prior segments. Obtain an authoritative Europe/London timestamp before work; record scheduled trigger, earliest actual start, next trigger, research_cutoff, hard_close_deadline and lateness. Never infer actual time from cron.

ANTI-OVERLAP TIMING RULE. The normal next trigger is one hour after the scheduled trigger. Define RESEARCH_CUTOFF = next scheduled trigger minus 7 minutes. Define HARD_CLOSE_DEADLINE = next scheduled trigger minus 1 minute. Forward research must stop by RESEARCH_CUTOFF. Preservation, CURRENT_STATE update, telemetry finalization and user-report preparation must be completed by HARD_CLOSE_DEADLINE. Do not continue cleanup, reconciliation or optional checking past the hard-close deadline. If something remains unfinished, record it explicitly and leave it to the next audit/reconciliation rather than consuming the next research trigger. The next scheduled trigger is never to be silently skipped because the previous session is still cleaning up.

50-MINUTE TARGET. Target at least 50 VERIFIED minutes of forward research whenever at least 50 minutes are genuinely available from earliest actual start to RESEARCH_CUTOFF. For a normally starting hourly session this target applies. If less than 50 verified minutes are achieved despite >=50 minutes being available, mark the session SHORT/NONCOMPLIANT unless all reasonable mathematical/audit/repair/regression/hostile-example/checker avenues were genuinely blocked by unavailable information/capability. Completion of a theorem, clean checkpoint, context compaction, GitHub write, tool failure or report readiness is not an exception. If the first invocation is late enough that fewer than 50 minutes remain to the research cutoff, target status is N/A but the lateness remains visible. Re-entry never resets the clock or target.

FORWARD-RESEARCH INTERVALS. Every claimed period of forward research must be a closed evidenced [start,stop] interval in the canonical record. On context handoff/compaction, close the current interval if the boundary is actually known. On re-entry, append a new interval to the same record. Missing boundaries are UNVERIFIED and are never inferred from commits, unit count, prose length, report time or schedule. Timestamp substantive units as they complete. The verified forward span is the union of closed non-overlapping intervals only.

SESSION EXECUTION. Do not stop because a single lemma, theorem, checker, computation, repair or subcase has completed. After every substantive unit immediately pursue the highest-value coherent follow-on that fits before RESEARCH_CUTOFF. Tool/infrastructure failure triggers a pivot rather than termination. Prefer depth on the independent #742 strip, graph-to-profile bridge, actual graph realizability and equality stability over unrelated exploration. Preserve failed approaches and hostile examples. Do not treat abstract scalar/profile feasibility as graph realizability.

EARLY-STOP CHECK. Before beginning preservation obtain a fresh authoritative timestamp. If more than 5 minutes remain before RESEARCH_CUTOFF and any sensible mathematical/audit step exists, continue research. Record the check and result. Begin preservation early enough to finish by HARD_CLOSE_DEADLINE.

FINALIZATION. Before reporting, finalize the canonical record with: session_id/scheduled_trigger; all segments; earliest actual start; next trigger; research cutoff; hard-close deadline; all closed forward intervals; verified forward span; forward stop; preservation start/complete; wall-clock span; substantive-unit count and timestamped ledger; early-stop check; stop reason; failures/pivots; commit SHAs; unfinished line; target applicability/result; and compliance status. Any mandatory missing/PENDING/inconsistent field makes utilisation UNVERIFIED/NONCOMPLIANT. Never fabricate historical times.

NO LOST HOURS. If old-session preservation or reconciliation somehow reaches the next trigger, it remains attached to the OLD session. The new scheduled trigger still has a distinct session identity and must start a new canonical record. If runtime/infrastructure prevents it from starting, record that trigger as MISSED or LATE with exact evidence; never merge it into the prior hour. Do not use high commit counts or productive surrounding hours to excuse a missed trigger.

HANDOFF. Update CURRENT_STATE.md with a compact mirror of the canonical session: scheduled trigger, earliest actual start, verified forward intervals and total, research cutoff, preservation complete, substantive units, stop reason, target result, compliance status, and canonical telemetry path. Keep README.md current when durable public-facing mathematical status changes. Preserve useful proofs, failed routes, scripts, exact outputs and dependencies. User-facing reports should be concise and end with the exact canonical session-utilisation summary. Finish and return before HARD_CLOSE_DEADLINE.

health.prompt:
Verify actual execution of the Independent #742 Research task (6ab23822ccfc819180460a39e879b68a) in paullenz/MurtySimon742. This is a lightweight, read-only health check; do not perform research, write repository files, modify mathematical claims, launch extra research runs, or retry tasks.

Obtain the actual Europe/London time, read CURRENT_STATE.md on main first, then inspect only the canonical session records and exact commits needed for the current and immediately preceding due research slots. Research triggers are HH:00:38 BST for hours 01–23, with a separate midnight audit. From 22 September 2026 10:00:38 onwards, require a remotely saved STARTED canonical record, timestamped substantive checkpoints (a ten-minute preservation backstop), and final closure by HH:59:38. Use SESSION_LOG_SCHEMA.md. Distinguish scheduled, requested, started, partial, completed and unverified. A run timestamp, admin commit, recovery incident file, or enabled flag is never evidence of mathematical execution. A manual recovery record does not retroactively complete a missed scheduled slot.

At each check:
1. If the current research trigger is at least ten minutes old and lacks a durable STARTED record, report it as MISSING_START / execution unverified.
2. If it has started but has no fresh evidence checkpoint for over fifteen minutes while its research window is still open, report STALE_CHECKPOINT, without asserting no work occurred.
3. Check the immediately preceding finished research slot for a completed canonical record, evidenced closed intervals, substantive units and preservation. Report missing, incomplete, SHORT/NONCOMPLIANT or blocked slots with the exact available evidence.
4. For the midnight audit, check for its dated saved audit/handoff after its hour closes; do not treat midnight as a missing forward-research slot.
5. If repository access fails, report MONITOR_BLOCKED with the exact error rather than declaring the research healthy.

Notify me when a new failure is found, a continuing failure has acquired another missed slot, or a previously reported failure has recovered with a verified substantive checkpoint. State the affected slot(s) in BST, last actual research checkpoint and link, and whether recovery remains unverified. Never claim the scheduler is fixed from configuration alone. If healthy with no changed condition, do not notify me. Use the task's prior reports only to suppress duplicate alerts, not as substitutes for repository evidence. This monitor ends with the existing time-boxed research window; do not extend it.
